answer: A concrete mechanism binds each answer to a memory-hard sequential proof whose cost grows with the amount of state a single identity must hold, so running many identities in parallel to share that work does not divide the difficulty. The proof is additionally bound to non-transferable tenure, which means a vine of bought or farmed reputation cannot be sold to the next operator. Consequently a fleet of many copies of river pays the full sequential cost several times over, and forging a good canyon requires holding tenure nobody can resell.
